Osun State Governor, Ademola Adeleke, has told the leadership of the National Union of Road Transport Workers that it was not invited to the venue of his second-term inauguration scheduled to hold on Friday in Osogbo. The governor said he did not recognise the current NURTW leadership across motor parks and garages in the state. This was contained in a statement signed by the spokesperson to the governor, Olawale Rasheed, obtained in Osogbo on Thursday, in reaction to reports of the union members’ planned attendance at the event. Adeleke said he had directed the state Commissioner of Police, Ibrahim Zungura, to stop the plan by the union leaders to attend the event and sanction those involved. “Mr Governor received reports of some NURTW members assembling at the old garage, Osogbo, with a view to attend the inauguration tomorrow. The reports indicate that they are armed and were brought in from some South Western States. NSCDC deploys 1,300 personnel for Adeleke’s inauguration Osun exempts statutory commissions, others from board dissolution Evening recap: Pete Edochie dies at 79, Adeleke dissolves cabinet, other top stories “It is important to affirm that the state government did not recognise NURTW; its activities across the state have been proscribed. A park management law is already under implementation in the state. Secondly, the government did not invite the NURTW to the inauguration event. “Any unholy assembly promoted by some elements within the NURTW is therefore an attempt to breach public peace. Mr Governor has already directed the state’s Commissioner of Police to take up the matter and prevent any likely breach of peace tomorrow”, the statement read. The PUNCH earlier reported that Adeleke had proscribed NURTW activities in the state in September following the shooting of Olalekan Oyeyemi, popularly known as Emir Ajagungbade, at Mayfair Park in Ile-Ife over a dispute concerning control of the park. The governor had then directed the police to fish out those responsible and announced that an executive order would be issued for a new park management service. Bola Bamigbola
